summary: OrganizationGraphPolicyV1 retains immutable ordered rules, tenant and role scope, source version, and canonical digest while remaining non-authoritative source governance.
Evaluation is resource and verified-scope filtering, then deny-ask-allow tiers, then source order; there is no automatic pattern-specificity ranking.
CompiledOrganizationPolicyV1 preserves source rule, order, approver role, reason, source/compiler digests, and evaluation provenance instead of lowering to bare decisions.
Tenant, principal, caller roles, capability, mode, and request/evidence digests must be independently resolved before policy evaluation.
The 036 authorization ledger is canonical; local policy JSONL is a linked projection and cannot supply allow authority.
Mode registry supplies stable mode identities and tool ceilings; organization policy binds its digest and can only narrow, never widen, those ceilings.
ASK opens a durable gate request; only fresh 036 reevaluation after a bound decision can yield allow or deny.
